title: Greek Chicken Souvlaki
description: Lemon, garlic and oregano marinated chicken skewers, grilled or broiled, served with homemade tzatziki, pita and tomatoes.
equipment: Skewers (soak wooden ones in water for 30 minutes)

image.alt: Chicken souvlaki skewers with lemon, tzatziki and pita

items.item: boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs

steps.text: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper in a bowl, add the chicken and toss. Marinate in the fridge for at least {time 30 min notimer}, up to 8 hours.
Make the tzatziki: stir together the yogurt, squeezed cucumber, garlic, dill and lemon juice with a pinch of salt. Chill until needed.
Heat the grill to medium-high, or the broiler with a rack {len 4 in} below it. Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving small gaps between pieces.
Grill or broil, turning every few minutes, until charred in spots and the chicken reads {temp 165F internal}, {time 10-12 min}.
Warm the pitas on the grill or in a dry pan. Serve the skewers with pita, tzatziki, tomatoes and red onion.

notes: Thighs stay juicier than breasts on a hot grill; cook them to 175°F.
Tzatziki keeps 3 days in the fridge and gets more garlicky as it sits.
